decisions.reason: The multi-model operator line is a core accessory to the garage door range, so it is likely to continue even though it has not appeared on the website since 2019, perhaps under updated model names.
The solid wood sectional door is a niche premium variant missing from the website for two years, but it still rounds out the one-source residential range at low cost.

This single remote-controlled operator overlaps with the broader operator line, has been absent from the website since 2019, and has most likely been absorbed into it, so its resources are better spent on the main line.
